name: Aircall
description: Aircall is a cloud business phone and customer-conversation platform for sales and support teams, combining calling, SMS/MMS, IVR, call recording, analytics, AI features, and CRM/helpdesk integrations in desktop and mobile softphones.
best_for: Sales and support teams that want a cloud phone system with CRM integrations, call routing, analytics, and optional AI conversation tools without deploying traditional PBX hardware.
features: Cloud calling with IVR, call recording, click-to-dial, SMS/MMS, and local or toll-free numbers
250+ integrations and API access on the Essentials plan
Advanced analytics, live monitoring, smart routing, callbacks, Power Dialer, and voicemail drop on Professional
Optional AI Assist, AI Voice Agents, and AI Messaging Agents
Custom plans for larger deployments with SSO, SLA, onboarding, and developer support

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: 3-license minimum; adds advanced analytics, monitoring, smart routing and sales productivity features.

tiers.name: Custom
tiers.notes: Custom pricing with 25-license minimum and additional enterprise controls.

pros: Published self-serve annual pricing for Essentials and Professional
Strong CRM/helpdesk integration footprint plus API access
Native desktop and mobile calling experience
cons: Essentials and Professional require at least 3 licenses
AI features and some channels add separate usage or per-license fees

alternatives.name: Dialpad
alternatives.description: Cloud business communications with voice, messaging, meetings, and AI features.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting integrated UCaaS and AI calling.

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: Cloud communications platform for voice, messaging, video, and contact-center workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting a broad unified communications suite.
